charts.title: Real Usage Index - primary target (weekly, first week = 100)
charts.query:
GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts  ->  fields: txn_fee (fees in NEAR)  (daily, public, no key)

-- Weekly returning signers: accounts that signed a transaction in a week AND in
-- any of the 4 previous weeks. A repeat user is much harder to fake than a new
-- account. Weeks run Monday-Sunday; block_date = the week's Sunday.
-- Partition filter on block_date (plus a 28-day look-back) keeps the scan bounded.
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    DATE_TRUNC(block_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week,
    signer_account_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
  WHERE block_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(@start_date, INTERVAL 28 DAY) AND @end_date
)
SELECT
  DATE_ADD(w.week, INTERVAL 6 DAY)            AS block_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.signer_account_id)         AS weekly_signers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(p.signer_account_id IS NOT NULL, w.signer_account_id, NULL)) AS returning_signers
FROM weekly w
LEFT JOIN weekly p
  ON p.signer_account_id = w.signer_account_id
 AND p.week BETWEEN DATE_SUB(w.week, INTERVAL 4 WEEK) AND DATE_SUB(w.week, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
WHERE w.week >= DATE_TRUNC(@start_date, WEEK(MONDAY))
  AND DATE_ADD(w.week, INTERVAL 6 DAY) <= @end_date          -- complete weeks only
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY w.week;
charts.sentence: The Real Usage Index (returning signers (BigQuery) and fees burned (NEAR)) went from 100 in the week of 2024-12-15 to 12.6 in the week of 2026-11-08.
charts.note: Primary target: repeat users and fees actually paid are hard for bots to fake. 'Active minus new accounts' is not used: NearBlocks new accounts can exceed active signers.

charts.title: Broad Adoption Index - secondary target (weekly, first week = 100)
charts.query:
-- Daily active accounts (distinct transaction signers) and transaction count.
-- Partition filter on block_date keeps the scan to the requested days only.
SELECT
  block_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) AS active_accounts,
  COUNT(*)                          AS transactions
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date;

-- Daily contract usage from the transactions table (cheap: ~3 narrow columns).
-- distinct_receivers: accounts/contracts that received at least one transaction
-- intents_direct_txs / _signers: transactions sent straight to intents.near
-- (Receipt-level function calls are in sql/optional/02b_contract_usage_receipts.sql;
--  that version scans ~318 GB per 6 months, so it is not run by default.)
SELECT
  block_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receiver_account_id)                                   AS distinct_receivers,
  COUNTIF(receiver_account_id = 'intents.near')                         AS intents_direct_txs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(receiver_account_id = 'intents.near', signer_account_id, NULL)) AS intents_direct_signers
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date;
charts.sentence: The broad Adoption Index (active accounts, transactions, contracts/accounts used) went from 100 in the week of 2024-12-15 to 5.2 in the week of 2026-11-08.

charts.title: NEAR Intents volume (USD, daily, 7-day average)
charts.query:
GET https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/near-intents  ->  totalDataChart (daily USD volume, public, no key)

GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions?startTimestampUnix=<hour start>&endTimestampUnix=<hour end>&numberOfTransactions=1000
Authorization: Bearer $NEAR_INTENTS_JWT
-> 2 random UTC hours per day (seeded by date), every swap in each hour (paged);
   swaps = mean(successful swaps per sampled hour) x 24 per day, x 168 per week
charts.sentence: NEAR Intents moved $125.81M a day over the last 30 days, against $128.3K a day in its first 30 days on DefiLlama.
charts.note: The Explorer API covers 1Click swaps only, a subset of all NEAR Intents volume, and each day is estimated from 2 sampled hours, so its line sits below DefiLlama's and is noisier. DefiLlama is used in the tests.

charts.query:

Authorization: Bearer $NEAR_INTENTS_JWT
-> 2 random UTC hours per day (seeded by date), every swap in each hour (paged);

charts.sentence: From 1362 sampled hours: about 115.7K successful swaps a week in the last 4 weeks, against 0.00 in the first 4 sampled weeks.
charts.note: Estimate from 2 random hours per day; median weekly relative standard error 10%.

charts.title: Fees burned on NEAR (NEAR per day, 7-day average)
charts.query: GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts  ->  fields: txn_fee (yoctoNEAR / 1e24)  (daily, public, no key)
charts.sentence: NEAR users paid 982.33 NEAR a day in fees over the last 30 days, against 4.7K NEAR a day at the start of the window.
charts.note: 2 April 2026: transactions -72% and fees -62% in one day while active accounts barely moved, consistent with one large automated sender stopping. That week and the next get a dummy in every test.
